name: Carrión de los Condes to Terradillos de los Templarios
notes: from is Carrión de los Condes (relation/340273, same point as stage 16 end). via: Monasterio de San Zoilo (amenity=place_of_worship relation/2953473; the Camino leaves Carrión past it, from memory), Calzadilla de la Cueza (node/273221786 place=hamlet; 16 km straight line from San Zoilo, with no village on the Camino in between, from memory), Ledigos. Terradillos de los Templarios = node/268521664 place=hamlet (Lagartos municipality); stage 18 must start at the same point. This is a long stage; common practice also stops at Calzadilla de la Cueza or Ledigos, but the app list ends at Terradillos.
